video_title: Darryn Peterson talks about comfortability in his role, finding his shots, team depth | 11.14.26

quotes.speaker: Darryn Peterson
quotes.summary_phrase: Darryn Peterson on finding his rhythm and shot selection
quotes.excerpt: I'm just starting to continue to find the shots that I like and which shots the coaches are encouraging.
quotes.quote: I'm just starting to continue to find the shots that I like and which shots the coaches are encouraging. It's a good amount of threes which I think I'm starting to find and get more rhythm with, off the dribble and off the catch. I'm just playing super aggressive and free and I think it's been beneficial.
quotes.social_post: Darryn Peterson says he is finding more rhythm in his shot selection and playing with more freedom as he adjusts to his role with the Jazz.

structured.context: Darryn Peterson discusses his offensive rhythm and shot selection during a media availability session.

quotes.speaker: Darryn Peterson
quotes.summary_phrase: Darryn Peterson on his offensive approach and getting to the rim
quotes.excerpt: a point of emphasis of mine is trying to go get easy shots at the rim.
quotes.quote: It's a little bit of both. It's kind of just depending on who's in the drop. It just depends on game to game, but definitely a point of emphasis of mine is trying to go get easy shots at the rim.
quotes.social_post: Darryn Peterson says a major point of emphasis for him is trying to get easy shots at the rim depending on the defensive coverage.

structured.context: Darryn Peterson explains his decision-making process when attacking the rim during games.

quotes.speaker: Darryn Peterson
quotes.summary_phrase: Darryn Peterson on playing against Kevin Durant
quotes.excerpt: After the tip ball goes up, I don't really think about who I'm playing against.
quotes.quote: It was cool. After the tip ball goes up, I don't really think about who I'm playing against. Pre-game I got to watch him work out a little bit and say what's up, so that was cool, but once the tip ball is our team versus theirs, it didn't matter anymore once the game started.
quotes.social_post: Darryn Peterson on facing Kevin Durant: It was cool to watch him work out pregame, but once the ball goes up, it is just our team versus theirs and it does not matter anymore.

structured.context: Darryn Peterson reflects on the experience of playing against Kevin Durant.

quotes.speaker: Darryn Peterson
quotes.summary_phrase: Darryn Peterson on the team's resilience despite injuries
quotes.excerpt: I think it just kind of speaks to the depth that we have.
quotes.quote: I think it just kind of speaks to the depth that we have. Obviously we came up short, but I feel like all the games that we've lost we've been right there. We're approaching getting over the hump, I think we will hopefully in this next stretch we have. I think we're super close, so just stay the course.
quotes.social_post: Darryn Peterson believes the Jazz are super close to getting over the hump despite recent losses and injuries, urging the team to stay the course.

structured.context: Darryn Peterson comments on the team's depth and resilience while dealing with injuries.

quotes.speaker: Darryn Peterson
quotes.summary_phrase: Darryn Peterson on his personal responsibility to execute the game plan
quotes.excerpt: I have to be able to execute the scout the entire 48 minutes.
quotes.quote: From my end, I have to be able to execute the scout the entire 48 minutes. Sometimes there's plays where I mess up or do something that we talked about not doing. I don't know for every player or everyone else feels the same way, but I think that's something on my end that I see.
quotes.social_post: Darryn Peterson says he needs to be better at executing the scout for the entire 48 minutes and cutting down on mental mistakes.

structured.context: Darryn Peterson discusses his personal need to improve at executing the team's game plan.

quotes.speaker: Darryn Peterson
quotes.summary_phrase: Darryn Peterson on the adjustment to the NBA schedule
quotes.excerpt: Probably just the amount of games and how fast the turnaround is.
quotes.quote: Probably just the amount of games and how fast the turnaround is. In college last year I would have like a week to prepare for a team. Now it's like we're playing somebody, sometimes we're playing somebody new the next day or a day off. Or we play a game and then practice, that's new for me. I think the biggest was like the training camp, it was super intense. That was probably the hardest I've trained for in a while, so that was probably my welcome to the NBA so far.
quotes.social_post: Darryn Peterson says the biggest adjustment to the NBA has been the rapid game schedule compared to college, noting that training camp was the hardest he has trained in a while.

structured.context: Darryn Peterson describes his transition to the NBA schedule and the intensity of training camp.
